ok_nomeado: (b) DDL das 5 vistas — seleção do usuário, 16/11
tarefa: fechar as 5 vistas sports_public_* com security_invoker=true

antes.def:
SELECT id,
    team_id,
    name,
    jersey_number,
    "position",
    status
   FROM sports_athletes
  WHERE sports_role_allowed(ARRAY['developer'::text, 'director'::text, 'coordinator'::text, 'secretary'::text, 'pedagogical'::text, 'aee'::text]);

SELECT id,
    match_id,
    team_id,
    athlete_id,
    event_type,
    points,
    period,
    clock_seconds,
    description,
    created_at
   FROM sports_match_events
  WHERE sports_role_allowed(ARRAY['developer'::text, 'director'::text, 'coordinator'::text]);

SELECT id,
    championship_id,
    sport,
    category,
    gender,
    home_team_id,
    away_team_id,
    scheduled_at,
    venue,
    phase,
    status,
    home_score,
    away_score,
    period,
    clock_seconds,
    started_at,
    finished_at
   FROM sports_matches
  WHERE sports_role_allowed(ARRAY['developer'::text, 'director'::text, 'coordinator'::text, 'secretary'::text, 'pedagogical'::text, 'aee'::text]);

SELECT id,
    name,
    city,
    logo_url
   FROM sports_schools
  WHERE sports_role_allowed(ARRAY['developer'::text, 'director'::text, 'coordinator'::text, 'secretary'::text]);

SELECT t.id,
    t.school_id,
    s.name AS school_name,
    t.name,
    t.sport,
    t.category,
    t.gender,
    t.crest_url,
    t.active
   FROM (sports_teams t
     JOIN sports_schools s ON ((s.id = t.school_id)))
  WHERE (bfr_is_schedule_manager() OR is_staff());
